Le premier cours de gym (A2; 8 lines; speakers Léa, Inès); targets: fr_timide_adj fr_sympathique_adj fr_courageux_adj fr_independant_adj fr_feminin_adj fr_brave_adj; sense notes: brave after the noun or after être = brave (une fille brave, elle est brave); before the noun it means good, decent (un brave homme). indépendant also means self-employed (un travailleur indépendant). féminin = feminine; une équipe féminine = a women's or girls' team.

Le mystère de la chaussette (B2; 10 lines; speakers Tom, Papi Henri); targets: fr_theorie_noun fr_raisonnement_noun fr_deduction_noun fr_philosophe_noun fr_reflexion_noun fr_intuition_noun fr_logique_noun fr_concept_noun fr_theme_noun fr_these_noun fr_notion_noun; sense notes: thème = a topic or theme; at school it is also a translation into the foreign language (un thème anglais). réflexion = thought, thinking; also a reflection in a mirror. thèse = a thesis, a position you defend; also a doctoral dissertation.

Le coin du conteur (C2; 10 lines; speakers La bibliothécaire, Léa, Inès); targets: fr_mythe_noun fr_deesse_noun fr_mythologie_noun fr_protagoniste_noun fr_faune_noun_m fr_philtre_noun fr_divinite_noun fr_conteur_noun; sense notes: un faune (masculine) = a faun; la faune (feminine) = wildlife, fauna. mythe also means a widely believed falsehood (c'est un mythe ! = that's a myth!). philtre = a magic potion, often a love potion in old tales.

Le roman de Maman (C1; 9 lines; speakers Tom, Maman); targets: fr_science_fiction_noun fr_intrigue_noun fr_personnage_noun fr_caractere_noun fr_trame_noun fr_mystere_noun fr_conte_noun fr_chronique_noun; sense notes: trame = the weft of a woven fabric; figuratively, the framework or outline of a story. caractère = temperament (avoir mauvais caractère = to be bad-tempered); also a printed character, a letter. intrigue = a plot, not only a scheme. chronique = a chronicle; also a regular newspaper column.

Le brouillard de la vue (C1; 9 lines; speakers Mme Petit, Tom, Léa, Inès); targets: fr_attentif_adj fr_perception_noun fr_silhouette_noun fr_flou_adj fr_visibilite_noun fr_argente_adj fr_eloignement_noun fr_aura_noun fr_subtil_adj; sense notes: flou = blurry; also vague, unclear (une réponse floue). éloignement = distance; also being sent away, removal. argenté = silvery; also silver-plated.

Les boîtes mystère (B2; 10 lines; speakers Mme Petit, Léa, Inès, Tom); targets: fr_toucher_noun fr_glace_adj fr_sensation_noun fr_mou_adj fr_collant_adj fr_pointu_adj fr_glissant_adj fr_rude_adj fr_sensibilite_noun fr_instinct_noun fr_legerete_noun; sense notes: rude = rough, harsh; also tough, hard (un hiver rude). It does not mean rude in the English sense (that is impoli). collant = sticky; also clingy (a person), and un collant = tights. pointu = pointed; also highly specialized (des connaissances pointues). légèreté = lightness; also levity, carelessness.

Le nez de Papi (C1; 9 lines; speakers Papi Henri, Léa, Tom); targets: fr_odorat_noun fr_fragrance_noun fr_exotique_adj fr_desagreable_adj fr_degout_noun fr_amer_adj fr_suave_adj fr_savoureux_adj fr_effluve_noun fr_subtilite_noun; sense notes: amer = bitter; also bitter in feeling (un souvenir amer). effluve = a waft, an emanation, pleasant or not; often plural (des effluves). suave = sweet and smooth (a scent, a voice), not 'suave' in the English sense of a charming man.

Le trésor du château (C2; 10 lines; speakers Tom, Papa, Léa); targets: fr_chateau_noun fr_forteresse_noun fr_rempart_noun fr_defense_noun fr_sentinelle_noun fr_donjon_noun fr_bastion_noun fr_bloc_noun fr_carrosse_noun fr_tresor_noun fr_oubliette_noun fr_blocage_noun; sense notes: oubliette = a castle's hidden pit-dungeon; tomber aux oubliettes = to be forgotten, shelved. défense = defense; also a prohibition (défense d'entrer = no entry) and an elephant's tusk. bloc = a block; also a political bloc, and un bloc-notes = a notepad. blocage = a block, a blockage; here a lock that blocks the door.

Le portrait de Léa (C1; 9 lines; speakers Léa, Papi Henri, Tom); targets: fr_portrait_noun fr_peintre_noun fr_modele_noun fr_fresque_noun fr_peinture_noun fr_mural_adj fr_tapisserie_noun fr_motif_noun fr_cadre_noun fr_encadrement_noun fr_toile_noun fr_retouche_noun; sense notes: cadre = a frame; also a setting (un cadre agréable) and a manager, an executive (un cadre). encadrement = framing; also supervision. motif = a pattern; also a motive, a reason. toile = canvas; also cloth and a spider's web (une toile d'araignée).

Les maladies d'autrefois (C2; 10 lines; speakers Tom, Papi Henri); targets: fr_pathologie_noun fr_cholera_noun fr_contagion_noun fr_tuberculose_noun fr_infection_noun fr_mortalite_noun fr_famine_noun fr_sang_noun fr_diabete_noun fr_pathologique_adj; sense notes: infection = an infection; informally also a stench (c'est une infection ! = it stinks!). pathologique = pathological; informally, excessive, obsessive (une jalousie pathologique). contagion = the spread of a disease; also the spread of a mood or idea.

La répétition de la chorale (C2; 7 lines; speakers M. Garnier, Léa, Inès, Tom); targets: fr_chorale_noun fr_gamme_noun fr_chanter_verb fr_cantatrice_noun fr_diva_noun fr_chanteur_noun fr_refrain_noun fr_chant_noun; sense notes: gamme = a musical scale; also a range or series (une gamme de couleurs; haut de gamme = high-end). refrain = a chorus; also the same old story (c'est toujours le même refrain). chorale = a choir, not a chorale (a hymn tune).

Le petit prodige (C1; 8 lines; speakers Léa, M. Garnier, Tom); targets: fr_tempo_noun fr_prodige_noun fr_pianoter_verb fr_sonorite_noun fr_piano_noun fr_accompagnement_noun fr_pianiste_noun fr_repertoire_noun; sense notes: pianoter = to drum your fingers (on a table) or to plunk at the piano; also to tap away at a keyboard. accompagnement = an accompaniment; on a menu, a side dish. répertoire = a repertoire; also an address book or a computer directory.

Le groupe de Tom (C1; 7 lines; speakers Tom, Papa, Léa); targets: fr_guitariste_noun fr_guitare_noun fr_vibrer_verb fr_rock_noun fr_jazz_noun fr_harmonica_noun fr_samba_noun fr_rythme_noun; sense notes: vibrer = to vibrate; also to be thrilled (faire vibrer le public = to thrill the audience).

La salle des cordes (C2; 9 lines; speakers M. Garnier, Inès, Léa, Tom); targets: fr_violon_noun fr_archet_noun fr_violoncelle_noun fr_contrebasse_noun fr_alto_noun fr_harpe_noun fr_baguette_noun_2 fr_chef_d_orchestre_noun; sense notes: baguette = a conductor's baton here; also a loaf of French bread, a chopstick and a magic wand (une baguette magique). alto = a viola; also an alto voice. archet = the bow of a string instrument (a bow for arrows is un arc).

Le grand boum (C2; 8 lines; speakers M. Garnier, Tom, Léa, Inès); targets: fr_cymbale_noun fr_xylophone_noun fr_triangle_noun fr_tuba_noun fr_trombone_noun fr_timbale_noun; sense notes: timbale = a kettledrum; also a metal cup and a dish baked in a mold. décrocher la timbale = to hit the jackpot. triangle = a triangle, the instrument or the shape.

On souffle ! (C1; 8 lines; speakers M. Garnier, Léa, Inès, Tom); targets: fr_clarinette_noun fr_hautbois_noun fr_basson_noun fr_saxophone_noun fr_cor_noun; sense notes: cor = a French horn; also a corn on the foot. réclamer à cor et à cri = to clamor for. hautbois = oboe (literally 'high wood').

Le vote du parc (A2; 10 lines; speakers Tom, Papa, Léa, Mme Lefort); targets: fr_probablement_adv fr_evidemment_adv fr_certes_adv fr_d_ailleurs_adv fr_cependant_adv fr_absolument_adv fr_finalement_adv fr_heureusement_adv fr_completement_adv fr_certainement_adv; sense notes: certes = admittedly, sure (it concedes a point before a 'but'). d'ailleurs = besides, moreover. finalement = in the end, eventually, not only 'finally' at last. certainement = certainly; also, in speech, probably.

La foire des associations (B2; 10 lines; speakers Maman, Léa, Tom); targets: fr_commune_noun fr_foire_noun fr_pauvrete_noun fr_generosite_noun fr_solidarite_noun fr_manifestation_noun fr_egalite_noun fr_inegalite_noun fr_tribu_noun fr_participation_noun; sense notes: manifestation = a demonstration, a protest march; also any public event (une manifestation sportive). commune = the smallest French local government unit, a town or village, not a commune in the English sense. égalité = equality; also deuce in tennis.

L'oiseau qui s'envole (B2; 8 lines; speakers Mme Petit, Léa, Inès, Tom); targets: fr_illustration_noun fr_dessin_noun fr_blessure_noun fr_pinceau_noun fr_animation_noun; sense notes: animation = animation (cartoons); also activities and entertainment (l'animation du village) and liveliness. illustration = a picture in a book; also an example that illustrates a point. dessin = a drawing; un dessin animé = a cartoon.

Le jeu des sons (C2; 8 lines; speakers Mme Petit, Tom, Léa, Inès); targets: fr_assis_adj fr_didactique_adj fr_phonetique_adj fr_ardu_adj fr_coherent_adj fr_incontestable_adj fr_conscient_adj fr_terminal_adj fr_civil_adj; sense notes: civil = polite (sois civil = be courteous); also civilian and civil in law (le mariage civil, at the town hall). terminal = final; in school, la terminale is the last year of French high school. conscient = aware; also conscious, awake. ardu = arduous, hard; also steep.

Le livre de fantômes (C2; 9 lines; speakers La bibliothécaire, Tom, Léa); targets: fr_angoissant_adj fr_immateriel_adj fr_inferieur_adj fr_sabbatique_adj fr_aspiration_noun fr_formel_adj; sense notes: formel = formal, official; also adamant, positive (je suis formelle = I'm quite sure, I insist). inférieur = lower (l'étagère inférieure = the bottom shelf); also inferior. aspiration = an aspiration, a dream; also suction (an aspirateur is a vacuum cleaner).

La voix de Papi (C2; 9 lines; speakers Tom, Léa, Papi Henri); targets: fr_anomalie_noun fr_astucieux_adj fr_rauque_adj fr_eraille_adj fr_inhabituel_adj fr_obsessionnel_adj; sense notes: éraillé = hoarse (a voice); also frayed or scratched (fabric, a record). rauque = raspy, husky. astucieux = clever, smart; it is not 'astute' in a cunning sense.

La collection de Papi (C1; 9 lines; speakers Papi Henri, Léa, Tom); targets: fr_suedois_adj fr_irlandais_adj fr_multicolore_adj fr_malais_adj fr_mexicain_adj fr_gaulois_adj fr_normand_adj fr_brusque_adj; sense notes: brusque = sudden, abrupt; also curt (of a person's manner). normand = from Normandy; une réponse de Normand = a noncommittal answer. malais = Malay; a stamp from Malaysia is more exactly malaisien.

Avant le spectacle (C1; 9 lines; speakers Inès, Maman, Léa); targets: fr_loge_noun fr_coiffer_verb fr_maquiller_verb fr_poudrer_verb fr_jongleur_noun fr_bizarre_adj fr_costumer_verb fr_fou_adj; sense notes: loge = a dressing room here; also a caretaker's lodge and a box in a theater. être aux premières loges = to have a front-row seat. se maquiller = to put on makeup; maquiller also means to disguise or fake (maquiller la vérité).

Le défilé du carnaval (C1; 8 lines; speakers Léa, Tom, Papa, Inès, Papi Henri); targets: fr_carnaval_noun fr_char_noun fr_danser_verb fr_defile_noun fr_talent_noun fr_acclamation_noun fr_celebration_noun fr_fetard_noun fr_amuser_verb; sense notes: char = a parade float here; also a chariot and, in the army, a tank (un char d'assaut). défilé = a parade; also a fashion show (un défilé de mode) and a narrow mountain pass. amuser = to entertain; s'amuser = to have fun.

La photo de famille (C1; 9 lines; speakers Maman, Tom, Papa, Léa); targets: fr_eleve_adj fr_monte_adj fr_pop_adj fr_realiste_adj fr_instantane_adj; sense notes: élevé = high; also well brought-up (un enfant bien élevé = a well-mannered child). monté = assembled, put together; also mounted (on a horse). instantané = instant; un instantané is also a snapshot.
